ways.label: Lower Tīmaru River Track

start.name: Lower Tīmaru River Track car park
start.quote: carpark at the start of the Lower Tīmaru River Track

end.name: junction with the Breast Hill Track
end.quote: junction with the Breast Hill Track

evidence: The marked track starts on the Tīmaru River's true left and crosses it several times during the first hour.
Lower Tīmaru River Track ends at the junction with the Breast Hill Track (part of Te Araroa).
The carpark at the start of the Lower Tīmaru River Track is 10 km from Lake Hāwea Township, on the unsealed Tīmaru River Road.

ways.label: Tīmaru High River Track
evidence: Tīmaru High River Track is signposted 50 m along the road.
For the last 900 m of the track, descend to Deer Spur Creek near Junction Hut (1.5 km).
From here you can return back the way you came, or cross the river and join the Lower Tīmaru River Track.

ways.label: Timaru River Loop
evidence: You can combine these two tracks into a day hike, walking the Tīmaru High River Track then crossing Tīmaru River and returning back to the car park via Lower Tīmaru River Track.

doubts: Page describes two tracks plus a combined loop (network). Lower track described as ending at the Breast Hill Track junction though it is introduced as 'to Deer Spur Creek'. High track start road is named differently from F2 (Dingle Burn Station Road) so start ref is null; W3 car park ref null (carpark is at the Lower track start, High track starts 50 m further). W2 shape taken from 'return back the way you came'.
